objective: Align VibeDesk's core authenticated UI with the supplied reference screens using existing local assets.

goal.metric: reference screens covered by reviewed UI implementations
goal.baseline: 3 core screens have dedicated reference-aligned components; authenticated preview is unavailable without backend
goal.target: 6 reference screen families use the established UI system and build successfully
guardrails: Do not alter VibeCore APIs, data contracts, or authentication behavior.

todos.text: Inspect remaining page implementations and map them to the reference screens.
Implement reusable reference-aligned shell, header, tables, cards, and illustrations across core page families.
Review the changed UI and run frontend verification commands.
Refactor VibeDesk folder structure, Redux async resource states, reusable hooks and Bootstrap UI; verify build and lint.
Audit unused frontend files and CSS, simplify with Bootstrap utilities, add accessible motion, and update VibeDesk README; validate lint/build/diff.
Create exactly 15 scoped VibeDesk commits using configured Git identity, verify branch, push and create PR targeting vibedesk.
